The companion figures (gate keeps 36 of them; they carry 1.62M of 1.77M) are correct.
issues.where: OUT/studies/h1_gate_audit/FINDINGS.md:182-183 (section 6 prose); also the study agent's final summary 'late_runners' entry
issues.evidence: Recomputed from data/minute/features.parquet IS rows: big & bars>60 -> 223 of 268, kept 36, net 1,616,633; h1_summary.json big_winners.by_hold: 121-375 n=131, 61-120 n=92 (sum 223); h1_minute_L1_by_hold_bucket.csv big column 131 + 92.

issues.what: Overstatement: 'Half of the skipped big-winner net on 1 min sits in two clocks (before 09:25 and the 14:00 bin)'. The two bins carry 242,281 + 297,023 = 539,304 of 1,478,374 skipped big-winner net = 36.5%, not half.

issues.what: The 5m L0 skip_only:BLOCK:clock artefact is described as 'the 5 SETUPs at or after 15:20 that the engine held for several sessions (mean +11,942 INR under L0)'. Under L0 the >=15:20 bin has 11 rows (the ledger row itself skips 11: kept 821 of 832), nine held 1 session, one 2 sessions and one 70 sessions; the +11,942 mean is driven by that single 70-session trade. The conclusion (an uncut-label artefact) still holds; the count and the 'several sessions' description do not.
issues.evidence: Ledger row a43e3a6e6e22f60e (5minute L0 skip_only:BLOCK:clock) kept 821 of n 832 -> 11 skipped; recount from data/5minute/features.parquet L0 IS rows with hour_bin '>=15:20': n=11, mean 11,942, fnd_sessions_held = [1,1,2,1,1,1,0,1,1,1,70]. The '5' is the L1 count (5 rows, all losers), not the L0 count.
issues.fix: State '11 SETUPs under L0 (5 under L1), one of which the engine held 70 sessions'.

issues.what: 'By hour the kept rows lose to the skipped in every bin but 11' on 5m/L1 is not literally true: the <09:25 bin also has kept > skipped (+1,859.5, from 2 kept rows at +1,912 vs 48 skipped at +53).
issues.fix: Say 'in every bin but 11 and the 2-row <09:25 bin'.

issues.what: Scope gap not stated: BRIEF H1 asks what 'ST7/ST8 (rooms, frozen rules) and ST5/ST6 skip'; the study audits ST7/ST8 only and never mentions ST5/ST6 or why they are out of scope (the cloud dataset carries only the ST7/ST8 fz block per data/README.md, and DESIGN_PANEL.md never names ST5/ST6).
issues.evidence: grep -i 'ST5|ST6' on FINDINGS.md returns nothing; grep -i 'ST5' on DESIGN_PANEL.md returns nothing; data/README.md line 9: 'FZ block: the frozen ST7 (1 min) / ST8 (5 min) fz block'.
issues.fix: Add one line to section 1 or 11: ST5/ST6 are not audited because the program dataset carries only the ST7/ST8 card and comparator.

issues.what: No CPCV path distribution was produced and the caveat only says 'the splitter is not used in this study' without saying why. This is defensible (the frozen gate has no chosen parameter; the variants are pre-declared decompositions; the one post-hoc trial not_block_asof fails go/no-go on kept_mean_slip8 and sign_blocks regardless of any CPCV number), and it does not affect the null result, but the justification should be explicit.
issues.evidence: h1_family_posthoc.json minute/L1 not_block_asof go_no_go: kept_mean_slip8>0 false (-1379.07), sign_blocks>=8/12 false (6); no 'h1/cpcv' rows in ledger/trials.jsonl (44 h1 rows, none under */cpcv).
issues.fix: State in the caveat that CPCV applies to searched/learned gates only and that no h1 variant has a searched parameter; note the post-hoc row fails two slippage-independent checks.
